pr_title: [browser] Fix encoding problem when publishing with AOT
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/83035.

- In native code we are checking if char is alphanumeric, if not we are replacing it with '_'. Unicode signs are treated as non-alphanumeric. To remain consistent, the same mechanism was added in the managed code, in `FixupSymbolName`.
- We need to block the test part where we check relinking due to https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/83497.

Issue Details
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/83035. - In native code we are checking if char is alphanumeric, if not we are replacing it with '_'. Unicode signs are treated as non-alphanumeric. To remain consistent, the same mechanism was added in the managed code, in `FixupSymbolName`. - MSBuild task's logger changes unicode's chars: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/004a2eb687eb57c58cf706e4edfa87858415add5/src/tasks/AotCompilerTask/MonoAOTCompiler.cs#L984 e.g. `煉` -> `_┼í┼»├ź` so that we cannot compare the build/publish output in the old way (using string contains). String comparison with the result that is displayed by the console (`_┼í┼»├ź`) is not effective either, so now we are checking for a regex.
